caption:
Mr Turtle wonders if regular massage will straighten out those rounded shoulders. Honestly? Not on its own.

Remedial massage can ease muscle tension, help you feel less stiff and make moving more comfortable. What it doesn't do is reshape your spine or change how you naturally stand.

Research suggests there's no single correct posture anyway. Staying in one position too long is usually the bigger issue. Massage works well alongside regular position changes and upper back strength work.

Pain spreading into the arm, pins and needles or building headaches are worth a physio check. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio.
